name: notes
description: Save and recall quick notes and facts. Acts as a personal knowledge base.
skillSummary: Save and recall quick notes and facts. Acts as a personal knowledge base the assistant can reference later. Supports tagging and full-text search.

tools.name: notes.save-note
tools.description: Save a new note or overwrite an existing one with the same title. Use when the user wants to remember something.

title.description: Short title / key for the note (used to retrieve it later)

tags.description: Optional tags to categorize the note (e.g. ["work", "contacts"])

tools.name: notes.get-note
tools.description: Retrieve a specific note by its exact title.

title.description: Title of the note to retrieve

tools.name: notes.search-notes
tools.description: Search notes by keyword (searches title, content, and tags).

tag.description: Optional: filter results by this tag

tools.name: notes.list-notes
tools.description: List all saved notes. Do NOT pass a 'tag' argument unless the user specifically asks to filter by tag. Omit the tag field entirely for a general list.

tag.description: Only set this if user explicitly asks to filter by a specific tag

tools.name: notes.delete-note
tools.description: Permanently delete a note by its title.

title.description: Title of the note to delete
